subtasks: Lift the basket more than 8 cm, identify the target object on the conveyor according to the image on the board, pick it up, and place it into the basket.

Hold the raised basket level with the left hand. Pick up the matching blue race car downstream with the right hand and release it completely inside the basket.
Regrasp the white basket by its handle with the left hand and lift it level more than 8 cm. Keep the right hand ready for the blue race car.
